risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~271% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.049), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.agent_rationale: Test a weighted combination using the full pool and the pre‑trained handle w1, which should give a robust weighted average across all 19 models.

attempts.rationale: Test a trimmed mean over the full pool to see if removing extremes improves robustness on this trend-dominated series.
Test a best_single strategy for the top model to see if a single model outperforms the robust combination.
Test a robust median of the small but stable pool1 to see if it beats the single model.
Try a robust median over pool2 to see if it beats the best_single.
Test a robust median over pool3 to see if it can beat the best_single strategy.
Test a simple mean over the more diverse pool4 to see if it can beat the best single DWT_catboost.
Test a weighted inverse-error combination on the more diverse pool2 to see if weighting improves over the simple mean or median.
Try a data‑aware Bayesian averaging on pool2 to see if it beats the best single DWT_catboost.
Test a robust median over the larger pool4 to see if it can beat the best single DWT_catboost while adding more models.
Test a weighted combination over pool4 using inverse_error to see if it beats the best_single DWT_catboost.
Test a simple dba combination on the smaller, more stable pool1 to see if it can beat the current best single.
Test a DBA combination over pool3, which has not been tried and may improve over simple means.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single DWT_catboost' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.6543. Series context: trend strength 0.9137 and seasonal strength 0.1721; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.049); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.301.
